scope: Finite paired unknown-pricing causal scope check, private candidate only, no model/API/DB/source mutation.

controls.text: 是否已计价未知，且已知同合约基准上涨，因此条件预计收盘上涨。
controls.expected: allow: separate unknown note followed by independent known baseline premise

controls.text: 计价状态未知，且来源确认需求下降，因此预计TTF价格下跌。
controls.expected: allow this local unknown guard: independent demand premise; other source validators still apply

controls.text: 计价状态未知；已知同合约基准上涨，据此作条件上涨预测。
基于市场基准观察到的价格上涨，且无证据表明上述公告已被计价，故预测收盘价上涨。

cause: premise_tail containing arbitrary 且/并且/加之 marks the earlier unknown as an evidential premise even when the later clause introduces an independent known directional fact.
minimal_requested_change: Do not borrow arbitrary conjunctions across the later independent premise; retain explicit causal/additional prefix before the unknown or an unknown immediately followed by the directional conclusion. Do not require a concession word for a valid unknown note.
